name: Signed Distance Field from Mesh
aliases: Signed Distance Field (SDF) for static meshes
definition: Rendering triangle meshes by converting them into Signed Distance Fields (SDFs). The MeshSDF class wraps an STL file and provides an implicit function f(point) -> scalar that returns the signed distance to the mesh surface.
summary: Signed Distance Field from Mesh converts a triangulated surface into a volumetric texture for implicit ray marching rendering, differing from slice-based methods by querying mesh geometry directly for every voxel.
